title: The 2020 Deliver to Win Truck Giveaway Winner!
summary: See who won a new Freightliner® Cascadia® 126 from Landstar in the 2020 Deliver to Win Truck Giveaway held virtually via Zoom video conferencing on Friday Sept. 18.
body_markdown:
